description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training examples and the overall ROUGE-G score for several models. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 16. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score" and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.0. There are five lines displayed: a blue dashed line representing Pegasus-X, which begins at approximately 16.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and decreases to approximately 15.5 when the number of training examples is 64; a green solid line representing PELMS, which begins at approximately 17.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and increases to approximately 17.5 when the number of training examples is 64; an orange dashed line representing Primera, which begins at approximately 15.5 when the number of training examples is 0 and increases to approximately 16.5 when the number of training examples is 64; a yellow dashed line representing Centrum (5%), which begins at approximately 15.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and increases to approximately 16.0 when the number of training examples is 64; and a purple dashed line representing Pegasus-X (5%), which begins at approximately 17.0 when the number of training examples is 0 and remains relatively steady at approximately 17.2 when the number of training examples is 64.
